Static-analysis deviation record for FB2-SW-DEV-000002 (src/app/driver/afe/adi/common/ades183x/adi_ades183x.c) mined from the in-source Axivion MisraC2012 style-check suppression. Linked to the AFE driver architecture because that design element owns 'PEC calculation and validation' and 'SPI/DMA communication with LTC AFEs' and this suppression is the PEC buffer placement that those responsibilities depend on. Coverage is PARTIAL: the design element is titled 'AFE Driver Architecture (LTC Family)' and its implementation_mapping lists only src/app/driver/afe/ltc/*, so the ADI ADES183x driver is a sibling AFE driver the as_is design does not actually cover. Relation meaning: the deviation record refines the design element with an evidence-backed, code-level documented exception. The record is NOT a verification of the design element - it performs no test, produces no result and provides no coverage of any requirement. It documents an implementation exception observed in the code that implements the design element, so an auditor can see that the design element's implementation carries a recorded, justified deviation from the project's stated MISRA C:2012 compatibility requirement. The link asserts the existence of the recorded deviation only; it does NOT assert MISRA conformance, tool qualification, or a completed ISO 26262 or ASPICE assessment.

Static-analysis deviation record for FB2-SW-DEV-000016 (src/app/driver/spi/spi_cfg-helper.h) mined from the in-source Axivion MisraC2012 style-check suppression. Directly within the ownership of FB2-SW-DSN-000001: the design element exposes the AFE_SPI interface (interface_id AFE_SPI, bidirectional, spi_tx/spi_rx) and these defines are the per-slave hardware chip-select masks that drive the CSn lines of that interface. The design's constraints record 'SPI clock <= 1 MHz (LTC6811 spec)' and its decision DEC-AFE-002 splits voltage and temperature reads, both of which depend on the CSn values these masks produce.
